metric_mechanisms.unexpected_weeds_lost: open-loop tape desync (S2): the fixed majority-vote route WATER/DIG/HARVEST is calibrated to the donor town tile layout; in a foreign town some PLANT->WEED transitions are not successful-harvest-retirements. Priced as lost_crop_tiles; recon desyncs LESS than the incumbent tape (DEV 478 vs 557).
metric_mechanisms.water_weeds_lost: same PLANT->WEED desync transition, fires jointly with unexpected_weeds_lost on the same tile (lost_crop_tiles prices the max of the two, no double-count).
